title: Loom façade client — cache-key completeness, stage-specific degradation, configured-but-unavailable backend

defects_addressed.evidence: VisionFlow/docs/estate-review/agent-grounding-and-governance.md — an AI-domain seed of 830 tokens was returned with cache_hit:true to a robotics request capped at 50 tokens; the key excluded domain and max_tokens.
defects_addressed.fix: cacheKey() now hashes field=value pairs for every entry of the named CACHE_KEY_FIELDS constant: query, model_tier, mode, depth, provenance, full, domain, max_tokens, budget (resolved ceiling), min_maturity, backend, generation. Absence collapses to one sentinel so null/undefined/'' cannot alias a value.

defects_addressed.evidence: Same review: a fixture where seed succeeded and expansion threw returned degraded:false with no error.
defects_addressed.fix: Degradation is stage-specific. Results carry degraded_stages drawn from DEGRADED_STAGES (seed | expansion | sparql | backend-unavailable) plus a named DEGRADED_OUTCOMES error. defaultExpandFn/loomExpandFn tag thrown SPARQL errors with stage:'sparql' so the sub-stage is nameable.

defects_addressed.evidence: ADR-2023 closeout extension: 'Define the behaviour of configured-but-unavailable Loom separately from the existing unset-URL VisionClaw selection.'
defects_addressed.fix: selectBackend() returns a named descriptor {name,url,configured,generation,reason}. An unset LOOM_FACADE_URL selects VisionClaw with reason loom_facade_url_unset_visionclaw_selected (not degraded). A configured Loom that fails on an availability/timeout cause returns error backend_configured_but_unavailable with stages [seed, backend-unavailable]; an unconfigured backend returns backend_not_configured; an auth/validation rejection returns seed_rejected and is NOT treated as unavailability.

cache_hit_policy.constraint_revalidation: Every cache hit is revalidated against the CURRENT request's constraints via cacheEntrySatisfies(); a violation is a MISS, never a served body.
cache_hit_policy.rationale: The stored Turtle has already been clamped once. A second deterministic cut would slice a seed mid-triple and silently change what the grounding asserts; a miss costs one retrieval, a bad truncation costs correctness.
cache_hit_policy.degradation_preserved: A cache hit replays the degraded flag and degraded_stages it was stored with — a partial answer stays partial.
cache_hit_policy.transport_faults_not_cached: A seed-stage transport failure returns without a cache write, so an outage cannot pin an empty answer for the TTL.

files_changed.note: one stale assertion updated: expansion failure now asserts degraded:true with the stage named

fixtures.backend-selection: 4 tests — Loom selected when LOOM_FACADE_URL set; VisionClaw when unset (reason recorded); injected vcFetch overrides; the selected backend is carried on every result.
fixtures.cache-hit-preserving-constraints: 3 tests — identical request served from cache with domain/budget/backend/generation intact; a stored PARTIAL result stays partial on replay; a stale-constraint entry is missed, not truncated.
fixtures.low-budget-after-high-budget: 1 test — 1000-token then 50-token cap for the SAME domain: cache_hit false, backend consulted twice, tokens_used <= 50, truncated true.
fixtures.domain-change: 1 test — identical query/tier, domain ai → robotics: cache_hit false, AI seeds gated out, tokens_used <= 50.
fixtures.expansion-failure: 3 tests — degraded true with ['expansion','sparql']; a transport fault adds 'backend-unavailable'; a clean run reports degraded false with an empty stage list.
fixtures.two-generation-activation: 2 tests — one shared cache, generations gen-1/gen-2: two distinct entries, second not replayed, repeat within a generation still hits; a per-request generation pin overrides the backend default.
fixtures.configured-but-unavailable-loom: 5 tests — ECONNREFUSED and timeout both yield backend_configured_but_unavailable; an unconfigured backend yields backend_not_configured; a 401 yields seed_rejected; a transport fault is never cached.
fixtures.cache-key-completeness: 2 tests — every one of the 12 enumerated fields changes the key; absent/null/empty collapse to one sentinel.

tests.note: pre-existing suite, still green after the change

limitations: These are helper-level fixtures with injected transports. They establish the client contract, not a live Loom round-trip.

Generation/bundle identity is honoured as an input (deps.backend.generation, LOOM_GENERATION, or a per-request pin). Binding it to the generation the Loom actually has loaded requires a Loom-side identity surface that does not yet exist; until then the value is asserted by configuration, not attested by the server.

The Loom expand helper still queries one merged graph and does not isolate asserted from inferred; the result's provenance field remains a REQUESTED scope. That limitation is unchanged by this work and is now visible alongside the backend name on every result.
